description: This file defines the RoutingMiddleware class in the Slim Framework, responsible for handling routing logic within HTTP request processing.

classes.name: RoutingMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware component that performs routing decisions based on the incoming server request, resolving route information or throwing exceptions when routing fails.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing RouteResolver and RouteParser dependencies.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main method called to handle a server request, performing routing and passing the request to the next handler.

methods.name: performRouting
methods.description: Performs the routing logic, resolves the route, and attaches route attributes to the request, or throws routing-related exceptions.

methods.name: resolveRoutingResultsFromRequest
methods.description: Helper method to resolve routing results based on the current request's URI and method.
